title: Reminder About Correct Coding of E/M Services

body:
The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid (CMS) issued a reminder about correct coding of Evaluation and Management (E/M) services. As part of their reminder, they mentioned a study report the Office of the Inspector General (OIG) that noted 42 percent of claims for E/M services in 2010 were incorrectly coded, which included both upcoding and downcoding (i.e., billing at levels higher and lower than warranted), and 19 percent were lacking documentation.

  • A number of physicians increased their billing of higher level, more complex and expensive E/M codes
  • Many providers submitted claims coded at a higher or lower level than the medical record documentation supports
